steps.what: List stored practice session slots
Plan and organize the practice sessions
Conduct the practice sessions in person
Sign the practice plan
File the signed practice plan
outputs: filed copy of signed practice plan v1

tasks.design: A job in {CALENDAR} lists stored practice slots and writes no athlete name. The coach plans, organizes, and conducts the practice sessions. A later job files the signed practice plan in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Session times were copied onto a sheet before practice.
tasks.enabler_now: Session date, location, and duration are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The coach still conducts the session.
tasks.human_edge: The coach decides what the session covers.
tasks.altitude: The coach spends the week on the field, not on listing slots.

reach.task: Train only on the session the coach signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says casting, game strategy, and judging artistry stay with people.

assumptions: Session date, location, and duration are stored on the practice record. The practice record produces them. A blank date is not a session. The list names no athlete.
Native configuration of the practice record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the coach signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the coach planning and organizing the practice sessions.

incremental.description: Refresh session date, location, and duration when the practice layout changes, and drop a plan the coach has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many session dates are blank. The high end assumes session date, location, and duration are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List stored training notes with no health text
Provide training direction and nutritional advice
Give encouragement and motivation for competitive events
Prepare athletes for games and tours
Sign the training direction
File the signed training direction
outputs: filed copy of signed training direction v1

tasks.design: A job in {DOCS} lists stored training notes and does not read injury text. The coach provides the training direction, the encouragement, and the nutritional advice, and prepares the athletes for games and tours. A later job files the signed direction. It does not judge health.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advice was repeated from memory at each game.
tasks.enabler_now: Session identifier and advice topic are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The advice is still spoken by the coach.
tasks.human_edge: The coach decides what advice fits the session.
tasks.altitude: The coach spends the week with the athletes, not on listing notes.

reach.task: Hear only the advice the coach signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says casting, game strategy, and judging artistry stay with people.
Digest [S16] says injury notes are health data. This design does not read injury notes and does not automate a health judgement.

assumptions: Session identifier, advice topic, and note type are stored on the training record. The training record produces them. A row whose stored type is injury is left out and its text is not read. A blank topic is not advice.
Native configuration of the training record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the coach signed is filed or sent.
The coach gives the nutritional advice. The job does not make a health judgement.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the coach providing training direction and nutritional advice.

incremental.description: Refresh session identifier and advice topic when the training layout changes, and drop a direction the coach has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many advice topics are blank. The high end assumes session identifier and advice topic are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List stored technique notes with no athlete score
Adjust coaching techniques based on the athletes
Judge the strengths and weaknesses in person
Sign the technique change
File the signed technique change
outputs: filed copy of signed technique change v1

tasks.design: A job in {DOCS} lists stored technique notes and writes no score. The coach adjusts the coaching techniques and judges the strengths and weaknesses. A later job files the signed change. It does not rank an athlete.
tasks.previous_blocker: Technique notes were kept in a private notebook.
tasks.enabler_now: Technique name and session identifier are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The adjustment is still made by the coach.
tasks.human_edge: The coach decides which technique changes.
tasks.altitude: The coach spends the week on the technique, not on listing notes.

reach.task: Follow only the change the coach signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says casting, game strategy, and judging artistry stay with people.
Digest [S11] says a system that filters or evaluates candidates, including for self-employment, is high-risk. This design does not filter or rank candidates.
The executive digest says ranking players to sign fits that high-risk reading. This design does not rank players.

assumptions: Technique name and session identifier are stored on the technique record. The technique record produces them. A blank technique name is not a change. The list is not a ranking.
Native configuration of the technique record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the coach signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the coach adjusting coaching techniques based on the athletes.

incremental.description: Refresh technique name and session identifier when the technique layout changes, and drop a change the coach has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many technique names are blank. The high end assumes technique name and session identifier are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List stored sports rules with no score
Instruct individuals or groups in sports rules
Explain game strategies and performance principles
Show ways of moving the body, hands, or feet
Sign the instruction note
File the signed instruction note
outputs: filed copy of signed instruction note v1

tasks.design: A job in {DOCS} lists stored sports rules. The coach instructs the individuals or groups, explains the game strategies and performance principles, and shows the movement. A later job files the signed note. Strategy stays with the coach.
tasks.previous_blocker: Rules were recited without a stored copy.
tasks.enabler_now: Rule identifier and sport name are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The instruction is still given in person.
tasks.human_edge: The coach decides which principle to teach.
tasks.altitude: The coach spends the week instructing, not on listing rules.

reach.task: Follow only the instruction the coach signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says casting, game strategy, and judging artistry stay with people.

assumptions: Rule identifier and sport name are stored on the rule record. The rule record produces them. A blank rule identifier is not taught as a rule.
Native configuration of the rule record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the coach signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the coach instructing individuals or groups in sports rules.

incremental.description: Refresh rule identifier and sport name when the rule layout changes, and drop a note the coach has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many rule identifiers are blank. The high end assumes rule identifier and sport name are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The coach spends the week on the field, with the athletes, and on the signed note. A stored list, an unnamed slot, and filing that signature can move. The coach still runs the session, chooses the people, and signs the note.
reach: An athlete trains only on the session the coach signed.
A parent sees only the note the coach signed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a schedule that names a player the coach did not assign.
Reject a scouting claim that does not restate a stored note.
Reject a letter or an order the coach has not signed.
role.ambitious_version: A signed schedule or report can be filed the same day, and the coach still owns the field.
